---
title: "Consultancy"
subtitle: "Quantitative epidemiology and zoonotic disease risk"
---

I take on independent scientific consultancy for international NGOs, government agencies and the vaccine industry. I am a disease ecologist and spatial epidemiologist with a clinical background in infectious diseases, so I can work across field ecology, clinical medicine and statistical modelling in one project.

## Services

I am available for short expert assignments and for longer collaborations in these areas:

- **Disease modelling.** Spatial and mathematical models of pathogen spillover risk and transmission.
- **Study and trial design.** Technical guidance on One Health trial design, transmissible vaccine frameworks and the evaluation of public health interventions.
- **Data synthesis and analysis.** Systematic reviews and meta-analyses of ecological and epidemiological data, such as host–pathogen sampling records.
- **Public health policy.** Evidence-based frameworks for emerging zoonoses and for monitoring antimicrobial resistance.
- **Training.** Workshops on spatial analysis in R, rodent-borne disease ecology and epidemiological monitoring.

My analyses are built in R and run on high-performance computing when the work needs it. Examples of the methods are on the [research pages](/research/), and the code for most of them is public.
